quotes.author: STaylor ● Tripadvisor
quotes.text: My husband and I did the Ultimate Adventure Tour for our anniversary and it was great! We traveled from out of town, and unfortunately the weather was hit or miss with rain & storms. The female employee (I'm unsure of her name) was amazing on keeping us updated on weather & rescheduling our flight for later that day. Our pilot Isaiah even contacted us by phone and updated us on weather as well. We did get to fly later in the day and we enjoyed every minute! Dain did a wonderful job getting us ready to go and Isaiah was a great tour guide with a great sense of humor! We will definitely be back!

quotes.author: Departure201454 ● Tripadvisor
quotes.text: My husband and I took the Eco Tour for our anniversary and it was worth every penny! I was a little nervous since this was my first helicopter ride; however, Linda and Michael immediately, made me feel at ease with everything. Our pilot was Isaiah. He was so nice and was a huge wealth of information about geographical facts and local information. Will definitely do this again!

quotes.author: elainehabicher ● Tripadvisor
quotes.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our helicopter ride. The pilots were very kind and helpful in explaining everything. It was a great adventure that everyone should experience. Isaiah was very informative during the flight and very helpful with taking some pictures for me. We really had a great time.
